claims.value: GLM-OCR is a multimodal OCR model for complex document understanding, built on the GLM-V encoder–decoder architecture with 0.9B parameters.
claims.evidence: GLM-OCR is a multimodal OCR model for complex document understanding, built on the GLM-V encoder–decoder architecture.
It introduces Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) loss... The model integrates the CogViT visual encoder... and a GLM-0.5B language decoder.
